description: the warlord of the reference picture riding: the same dark horned helmet, the same thick brown beard and glowing red eyes, the same dark red and black plate armour with glowing orange cracks like embers, the same belt of small skulls, the same long dark red cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, its edge clean and outlined, dark armoured boots, nothing in the hands but the reins, no axe; sitting astride a saddle that is not drawn, upright, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the head, chest and hips turned fully to the right; both forearms reaching forward, the two gauntleted hands together in front of the body holding short reins that end just in front of the hands; only the near leg showing and only one foot in the whole picture: the armoured thigh lying forward and level from the hip to the knee, the armoured lower leg hanging straight down from the knee, one whole dark armoured boot at the bottom with the toes pointing right; the far leg completely hidden and not drawn at all, no second boot and no second foot; the whole figure from the tips of the helmet's horns to the sole of the boot inside the picture with room around it; nothing under the rider; isolated figure on a plain background

references.usage: the character's look: this same man, his face, beard, horned helmet, armour with glowing cracks, skull belt, cloak and colours, drawn the same way; not his standing pose and not the axe in his hands
